en: \[VSCode] Fixed holding Enter on `/rewind` restoring files, and a double click on Remove or Delete removing a memory, MCP server or plugin marketplace, without confirmation
zh: \[VSCode] 修复在 `/rewind` 上按住 Enter 会恢复文件，以及在 Remove 或 Delete 上双击会在未经确认的情况下移除 memory、MCP server 或 plugin marketplace 的问题
